[me] suggested it might have been a hotfix that was never merged into the development branch. After checking release branches and hotfix branches, [p1] confirmed no evidence was found initially.

Ultimately, [me] located the relevant code/functionality. It was revealed that [me] committed to a hotfix branch on March 24th, but another participant merged this into development on March 31st without pulling the latest server version.
decisions: The location of the tag filtering functionality was successfully identified.
